description: Any record_read while FamilySearch is not answering: the error record-read.ts throws when fetchWithRetry exhausts its budget and returns the last 504 response, marked is_error because src/server.ts returns {error} with isError: true. Registers record_read for ut_research_fl2 (issue #4777), which runs search-records live; with every record_search timing out there is no record to read. Pairs with record-search-timeout-any-surname and record-search-timeout-any-country.
